# @mission-platform/tokens

Design tokens for Mission Platform, defined in the **DTCG** (Design Tokens
Community Group, https://www.designtokens.org/) format.

- Schema: **DTCG v2025.10**
- Colour space: **OKLab** (`oklab(L a b / α)`)
- Generator: `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-tokens` (runs during `vite build`)

## Source of truth — `tokens/*.tokens.json`

Edit these DTCG files only; never edit the generated output.

- `palette.tokens.json`      — primitive colour palette (`color.primary.600`, …), OKLab
- structural scales — one DTCG file per scale (the plugin merges them by top-level group):
  - `breakpoint.tokens.json`   — responsive `breakpoint.*` thresholds
  - `spacing.tokens.json`      — `spacing.*` margin/padding/gap scale: the numeric `0…24` 4px base-unit steps plus the named `2xs … 2xl` t-shirt scale consumed by the component `padding`/`margin`/`gap` props
  - `radius.tokens.json`       — `radius.*` border-radius scale (rem; `full` is the `9999px` pill sentinel)
  - `shadow.tokens.json`       — `shadow.*` elevation + focus-ring scale (rem offsets/blur/spread)
  - `size.tokens.json`         — the unified component `size.*` scale (font/pad/gap/icon/height/…)
  - `motion.tokens.json`       — `duration.*` and `easing.*` (transition/animation timing)
  - `z-index.tokens.json`      — `z-index.*` stacking order (`base` → `toast`)
  - `opacity.tokens.json`      — `opacity.*` alpha levels (`disabled`, `muted`, …)
  - `border-width.tokens.json` — `border-width.*` (`thin`/`thick`/`heavy`), rem

All dimension scales (spacing, radius, shadow, size, border-width) are expressed in **rem**
relative to the `14px` root font-size (set in `scss/tokens`) so they scale with the user's
font size; only `breakpoint.*` stays in absolute **px** (rem in a media query is relative to the
browser root, not `:root`) and `radius.full` keeps its `9999px` pill sentinel.
- `font.tokens.json`         — primitive font scales: `font.family` (sans/mono), `font.size`,
  `font.weight`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`
- `typography.tokens.json`   — composite typography styles (DTCG `typography` type): `display`,
  `h1`–`h6`, `body-lg`/`md`/`sm`/`xs`, `label`, `caption`, `code` — each composed from the
  `font.tokens.json` primitives via aliases (`{font.size.4xl}`, …) plus the `marginBlock` /
  `marginInline` logical-margin steps aliased from `spacing.tokens.json` (`{spacing.3}`, …)
- `theme-light.tokens.json`  — light-theme semantic colours (`color.bg.*`, `color.primary.*`, …)
- `theme-dark.tokens.json`   — dark-theme semantic colours

Fonts: primary sans is **Comfortaa**, primary mono is **Datatype** (with fallbacks).

Every group and token carries a DTCG `$description` documenting its intent (hue/role for
colours, px equivalents and usage for the scales). The plugin emits these descriptions as
`///` SCSS doc comments / JS doc comments in the generated output — so keep them accurate
when editing a token.

## Generated output — `src/generated/` (do not edit)

- `_palette.scss` / `_scale.scss`            — unprefixed `$color-*`, `$font-size-*`, … SCSS variables
  (`_scale.scss` also carries the `font.tokens.json` `$font-*` / `$line-height-*` / `$letter-spacing-*` vars)
- `_structural.scss`                          — `:root { --mp-* }` structural + font CSS custom properties
- `_typography.scss`                          — composite `--mp-typography-<variant>-*` CSS vars (each
  referencing the matching primitive `--mp-*` token)
- `_theme-light.scss` / `_theme-dark.scss`    — selector-scoped semantic `--mp-color-*` vars
- `flat.ts`                                    — flat `as const` token values
- `tokens.ts`                                  — nested TypeScript API (re-exported by `src/tokens.ts`),
  including the `typography` map (`typography.h1.fontSize`, …)
- `tokens.css`                                 — standalone CSS bundle (structural + font + light theme)

## Usage

TypeScript:

```ts
import { colors, spacing, fontSizes, typography, sizeIcons } from '@mission-platform/tokens';
// typography.h1 => { fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, letterSpacing, marginBlock, marginInline }
import { durations, easings, zIndices, opacities, borderWidths } from '@mission-platform/tokens';
// durations.fast => '150ms'; easings.standard => 'ease'; zIndices.modal => 1300
```

Motion, layering & box-model CSS custom properties (prefer these over inline literals):

```css
.control {
  transition: background-color var(--mp-duration-fast) var(--mp-easing-standard);
  border: var(--mp-border-width-thin) solid var(--mp-color-border-default);
}
.control:disabled {
  opacity: var(--mp-opacity-disabled);
}
.dialog {
  z-index: var(--mp-z-index-modal);
}
```

Composite typography CSS custom properties (preferred over the legacy SCSS mixins):

```css
.headline {
  font-family: var(--mp-typography-h1-font-family);
  font-size: var(--mp-typography-h1-font-size);
  font-weight: var(--mp-typography-h1-font-weight);
  line-height: var(--mp-typography-h1-line-height);
  letter-spacing: var(--mp-typography-h1-letter-spacing);
  margin-block: var(--mp-typography-h1-margin-block);
  margin-inline: var(--mp-typography-h1-margin-inline);
}
```

SCSS (structural CSS vars + base resets + the `light-dark()` theme — one import):

```scss
@use '@mission-platform/tokens/scss/tokens';
```

`scss/tokens` emits the semantic colour tokens as `:root { color-scheme: light dark;
--mp-color-*: light-dark(<light>, <dark>) }`, so by default the UI follows the OS
`prefers-color-scheme`. It also ships the opt-in scheme pins, so adding
`data-theme="light|dark"` (or the `.theme-light`/`.theme-dark` classes) to any
element pins that element **and its subtree** to one scheme — no extra import is
needed (the legacy `scss/themes/{light,dark}` entry points are kept only as
no-op back-compat shims). Runtime theme switching is handled by
`@mission-platform/components` (`BaseThemeProvider`/`useTheme`/`BaseThemeToggle`,
plus `themeInitScript()` for a flash-free pre-paint init).

Typography mixins (legacy — being retired in Phase 2):

```scss
@use '@mission-platform/tokens/scss/mixins' as mp;
.label { @include mp.mp-font('label', $weight: 'medium'); }
```

> **Phase 2 (in progress):** the SCSS `mp-font-*` mixin layer is being incrementally
> retired in favour of composing the generated `--mp-font-*`, `--mp-line-height-*`
> and `--mp-letter-spacing-*` CSS custom properties directly. New code should prefer
> the CSS variables; `BaseTypography` (in `@mission-platform/components`) has already
> been migrated as the first consumer.

Plain CSS (no SCSS toolchain):

```css
@import '@mission-platform/tokens/css';
```

Breakpoints (the responsive SCSS layer lives here; the `useBreakpoints` composable and
`<ShowAt>`/`<HideAt>`/`<BreakpointDebug>` components remain in `@mission-platform/breakpoints`).
The seven threshold **values** are design tokens (`breakpoint.*` in `breakpoint.tokens.json`,
generated as `$breakpoint-2xs` … `$breakpoint-2xl` in `src/generated/scss/_breakpoint.scss`); the
SCSS partials (`src/scss/_breakpoints.scss`, `_breakpoints-utilities.scss`) are hand-authored
wrappers that build the `$breakpoints` map and mixins directly from those generated breakpoint
properties:

```scss
// $breakpoints map + bp-up/bp-down/bp-between/bp-only mixins (no emitted CSS):
@use '@mission-platform/tokens/scss/breakpoints-mixins' as bp;
.sidebar { @include bp.bp-up('lg') { width: 18rem; } }

// The .bp-show-*/.bp-hide-*/.bp-only-* visibility utility classes (emits CSS):
@use '@mission-platform/tokens/scss/breakpoints-utilities';
```

## Scripts

- `pnpm --filter @mission-platform/tokens build` — generate artefacts (via the Vite plugin) + build

## Adding or changing a token

1. Edit the relevant `tokens/*.tokens.json` file (DTCG v2025.10, OKLab colours).
2. Run the build — the SCSS/CSS/TS output is regenerated automatically.
3. Never hand-edit `src/generated/`.
